A '''mind prison''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[mind prison]] in which [[Darth Nul]] was imprisoned inside the [[Emperor's Fortress]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as one of [[Tenebrae]]'s possessions.<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|encountered]] Nul while inside the mind prison.<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" />
